reviews.text: Wonderful daycare!! My dog ​​Ayla is super timid, but she adapted really well there and spends the day having fun! The staff is very friendly and caring, they send videos all day long, observe the dogs' behavior and needs, and even send a message at the end of the day with everything that happened! I highly recommend it!!

My dog ​​loves staying there, she's very well cared for. Everyone is very attentive and concerned. The overall quality of their work is undeniable. The service provided is excellent for the owners, problem-solving, communicating anything out of the ordinary, and the entire routine is explained with detail and care!

Since the day it opened, my pet Frederico Gabrioli has been going to this daycare. That's three years already! All the staff are of the highest quality, responsible, and love what they do. Because of this, my son is always very well cared for, and I am completely satisfied. I want to emphasize that I have already recommended it to several other pet owners, and they are also very satisfied. I am very, very grateful to be at Casa Doggy with my son. Eternal gratitude to everyone!!

Diego is a puppy with separation anxiety, and Doggy House was suggested by his trainer. He's welcomed and loved by all the humans and canine companions. He loves going there. They are attentive, send videos, photos, daily reports, and are alert to any accidents or special needs. And besides that, they do training, and Diego has progressed a lot. I leave him at Doggy House with a clear conscience.

The doggy house was very attentive and careful with my dog's adaptation, listening to his concerns and managing to help him adapt super well! He loves going there and is super happy! They send lots of videos, photos, and information about him throughout the day! I only have praise!

Best dog daycare in Rio de Janeiro, no exaggeration! The staff is super attentive and takes care of the dogs as if they were their own. The environment is clean, safe, and full of activities; you can see that they really care.
My dog ​​arrives very excited and always comes home happy and tired (the perfect combo 😂). I feel completely at ease leaving her there. I recommend it without hesitation! ❣️🐾

Best dog hotel in Rio!!!
My dog ​​loves spending time there, she learns commands, plays, burns off energy, and I get real-time updates on everything via WhatsApp!
They provide excellent service. Attentive and caring with the games.

Casa Doggy is a very special place. They don't just take care of your dog for you. They educate them, give them love and affection, and truly care about them. My dog ​​almost bursts with joy when she arrives. I'm always very reassured because they keep me updated all the time. It's a safe and fun place. The fact that all the professionals there are incredible and kind is a wonderful bonus.

I'm in love with Casa Doggy. Everyone is so caring and attentive. I leave my dog ​​there with peace of mind, whether for daycare/daily stays or long-term boarding. The staff sends photos and updates constantly and organizes lots of really fun activities with the dogs. I love it and highly recommend it!

Casa Doggy is really great, with a responsible, trained, caring, and very loving team! Brenda went first, and Sofia followed! Today, they both have a lot of fun. We received some really cool videos during the day and special feedback at the end of the day. Congratulations to everyone for their dedication and commitment to our happiness and that of our beloved pets!

My little ones have been attending daycare for 3 years. They simply love it! Even in the car, when we approach the daycare, they already want to get out! They always greet the caregivers enthusiastically. The affection, attention, and real-time information they provide about their care make a huge difference. They even teach various training commands. We simply love Casa Doggy.

Karlos' happiest days at daycare!
When he gets outside, he starts running towards the Doggy House. He arrives already playing, then there's "study" time to practice commands and obedience, of course followed by a nap because nobody's made of iron. Finally, playtime returns until it's time to go home.
He arrives home ready for "dinner" and to sleep peacefully.
Mom and Doggy love this place!

Since 2023, Chico has been attending the Casa Doggy daycare and he really enjoys it. Besides socializing with other dogs, he has activities and training sessions. The staff is very attentive and caring towards Chico.
Amazing, they take great care of our dogs, dedicated professionals and lots of fun!

Casa Doggy is an amazing place. You know they care about your pet when they get so excited to come back. Paçoca loves going to Casa Doggy. I always use their hotel service, which is wonderful too. I highly recommend it.

They take very good care of Spock, my Australian Shepherd, who is a medium to large-sized dog.
He really likes the place, and he's very happy when I take him to daycare. When I pick him up, he's even tired from so much playing and activities.
At Casa Doggy, they always inform you how the dog's day went, as well as if there were any problems.

The joy my dog ​​Joaquim shows when he arrives at Casa Doggy's door assures me of how well he is cared for! The team is extremely caring and dedicated, sending us videos of his daily activities, conducting training sessions, playtime, administering his medication on time when necessary, and warming my heart by sending the best photos of Joaquim! I highly recommend them!

My puppy loved the experience with the monitors and the other dogs. The staff is very attentive and patient. There are several activities that the dogs love, and they come home happy.
I really enjoyed it and recommend it.
Best family with lots of Bigode's furry friends! A place for happy dogs 🐾🐶🐕 …
My trusted place to leave my dog ​​while I travel. They are always very attentive, sending photos, videos, and updates.

Casa Doggy is an amazing place! Besides being an oasis for dogs, it's also a lot of fun for owners! They send videos, take wonderful photos, the kind of thing pet moms love! They socialized my puppy there when she was still a puppy, and she also learned several important commands! I'm a fan!

Attentive, caring, and highly competent staff! My little girl was welcomed with open arms, and even though she's usually quite reserved, I see that she enjoys her time at Casa Doggy more each day. Thank you everyone!
Attentive, caring, and capable staff. I have complete confidence leaving my Dudu with them at the daycare and boarding facility.

Excellent daycare and hotel. Hani has been attending since it opened, which is 3 years ago. He enjoys it a lot, does plenty of activities, receives lots of affection, and comes home physically and mentally exhausted.
They send videos and photos of everything your dog is doing.
The place is clean and well-maintained.
The staff is wonderful, always very attentive, paying attention to everything that is happening with the dogs.
At the end of the day, you receive a report on how your dog behaved.
I feel very safe leaving my pet at this daycare.
I highly recommend it.
If you're looking for a safe, clean, and loving place to leave your dog, you've found it. The team at A Casa Dog treats every dog ​​like family.
An excellent daycare and boarding option for dogs, with super special care provided by Gabriela and the entire team!!

It's impossible to be good without air conditioning!
The dogs and caregivers are in the sweltering heat!
It's only cool in the reception area where you wait for your pet.
In this heat, even if it were free, it wouldn't be suitable!

The perfect place to leave our dogs. The staff organize educational and interactive activities, are super caring, and even send us videos throughout the day to keep us updated. I feel very safe and at ease when I need to travel because I know my Uly has a second home.

This place is super professional and attentive to our dogs. They even make videos of how they're enjoying their stay, and they offer training and bathing services. My dog ​​loves it, I highly recommend it.

Amazing place to leave your pet with confidence!
Wonderful team, always very attentive to the owner and with all the care and love for our pets. They are very flexible and always try to meet our demands.
Nico loves spending the day there, he's happy just to realize he's getting close to daycare.
They have daily activities always supervised and send us videos of everything!
I recommend them without hesitation, I leave Nico there with complete peace of mind, both for daycare/daily stays and even for longer stays.
Excellent service, they take very good care of the pets!

An amazing place to leave your pet. Excellent staff, activities, and care for the pets. I love it and highly recommend it. Both for boarding and daycare during the week.
My dog ​​also loves it, he comes home exhausted from playing so much with his doggy friends.
They were very careful and welcoming. Brisa is super wary, but they managed to win her over and were very patient during the adaptation process.

My dog ​​Sheik loves Casa Doggy! Every time he passes by the door he wants to go inside, haha. He loves playing with his doggy friends and adores the staff, who are very attentive and caring towards him! I recommend it without hesitation!

Excellent daycare with a clean space and many educational activities, both individual and with the whole group. Smaller dogs are separated from larger ones. Very attentive and caring staff. They always send updates with photos and videos, as well as a "report card" at the end of the day! I recommend it!

They treat our dogs with great care and responsibility! They are very affectionate, send several videos and photos throughout the day, and always let us know when they notice something different. They do activities that stimulate self-control, sense of smell, and energy expenditure. The house structure is great, including a sunny outdoor area. Communication is very good, and they are always available to try to help when we have any questions. I highly recommend them!

Casa Doggy is simply fantastic, all the girls are so caring towards our pets, they make videos and make us feel really comfortable leaving our beloved pets there. Congratulations on the excellent work, I recommend it to everyone with complete confidence. Our Amendoim loves spending the day there.

Casa Doggy has serious, dedicated professionals who care for the dogs with great affection. They are also attentive to the owners, sending videos of tasks, taking photos during holidays, and teaching commands to the dogs. It's a place I recommend and trust! My dog ​​(Paola) loves it! They also offer boarding.

Doggy House is simply wonderful! The staff is extremely reliable, attentive, and loving—you can see the affection they have for each animal. Ginja loves going there; she gets so excited when she realizes she's on her way. I always feel reassured knowing she's in good hands, having fun, and receiving great care. I recommend them without hesitation!
A place full of LOVE and professionalism! Caring treatment and lots of dedication!
Always very attentive and helpful, plus the space is great.
Amazing place to leave your dog!
My dog ​​loves going to Casa Doggy. The staff are attentive and helpful.
All the staff are patient, loving, and very kind to all the animals. They are genuinely concerned about the dogs. I highly recommend them.

I highly recommend it! And Confete too! She goes there so happy and, best of all, comes back ready to sleep after burning off all that energy!!!! I feel at ease when she's there. I know she's cared for with all the love and affection. Attentive and dedicated professionals. I'm so grateful to have Casa Doggy as support and a second home for our four-legged daughter!!! 🤍

The best place in the world for our beloved doggies! There they are treated with so much love, learn various commands, and burn off lots of energy! They come back tired and very happy! They love Casa Doggy! My Theo has been going for a long time, and after I adopted my Bella, she started going too and loves it! Best investment ever! Jacqueline, Angélica, Naldo, Gabi, and everyone on the team are wonderful, words can't express my gratitude. They send videos and photos showing the activities they do, like "treat hunts" and "commands." How good it is to have the peace of mind of leaving our pet children in a place like this! I highly recommend it!
